We provide advanced fault code deactivation services

This service is always free, as AI learns from your files and continues to improve.

We provide advanced fault code deactivation services, designed to enhance the performance and reliability of your vehicle’s ECU by safely eliminating any unwanted or unnecessary DTC.

ECU Fault Code Deactivation

We offer professional fault code deactivation services for a wide range of ECUs from various manufacturers. Supported models include:

  • Bosch: EDC15, PSG16, ME1.5.5, ME7, ME7.3.2, ME7.6.x, EDC16, MED9, EDC17, MED17, MD1CP001, MD1CP002, MD1CP004, MD1CS001, MD1CS003
  • Delphi: DCM3.4, DCM3.5, DCM3.7, DCM6.2
  • Siemens/Continental: PCR2.1, PPD1.x, SIMOS3, SIMOS7, SIMOS18, SID208, SID807, SID30x
  • Magneti Marelli: MM9GV, IAW7, MJD6, MJD8, MJD9, MJD6Ox
  • AC Delco: E78, E83, E84, E87, E98
  • Denso, Hitachi, Valeo, Temic, ...

Ensure optimal performance by safely removing unwanted fault codes.
